response.sql: SELECT death_country, avg_points, avg_points - AVG(avg_points) OVER () AS diff_from_avg_of_avgs FROM (SELECT p.death_country AS death_country, AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points FROM player_award_vote v JOIN player p ON v.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.death_country) <> '' GROUP BY p.death_country) t
